description.zh: 把一个窗口（被审查者）绑定到另一个窗口（审查者）：被审查者 AI 输出结束后自动触发审查者按其角色卡与要求输出审查意见。含独立侧栏面板（绑定窗口/角色卡/审查要求/历史）与手动触发、提示词预览。
description.en: Bind one chat (reviewee) to another (reviewer): when the reviewee's AI finishes a turn, the reviewer automatically produces a review using its own character card and your requirement. Includes a sidebar panel for binding, character cards, requirement, history, manual trigger and prompt preview.

description.zh: 让 AI 可以查询/修改审查绑定、查看审查历史、手动触发一次审查。
description.en: Lets the AI inspect/modify the review binding, read review history, and trigger a review manually.
